ModDescription: Groundcover with grass. iOS textures-only bundle: the five textures the port's forced configuration loads - upstream's realistic Grass_tex plus the GrassDetails_01/06 flower and tuft layers (all three VMblast's, authorized for this project only - see LICENSE; this bundle ships on the private test draft only), and the two Classic-style billboards BrownGrass_tex (Desert) and GreenGrass_tex (the Classic fallback). The mod's C# is compiled into the app (Assets/Scripts/Game/Mobile/Ports/RealGrass), so this manifest ships no scripts, no meshes and no materials: the port renders upstream's Full style as texture prototypes in DetailRenderMode.Grass, never as the FBX prototypes, whose materials are on the Standard shader. Upstream declared DFUnity_Version 0.15.3; this bundle is built for and verified against 1.1.1.
